summary:
dual-mode wireless electric vehicle charging system capable of both static and dynamic inductive power transfer.
Using transmitter coils embedded in parking spaces and roadways alongside a vehicle-mounted receiver coil, our prototype enables seamless, cable-free energy delivery whether a vehicle is parked or in motion.
This dual approach directly solves major electric vehicle adoption challenges, including range anxiety, frequent charging stops, and the inconvenience or wear of physical plug-in cables. Vehicles can top up their batteries while driving over electrified road segments and automatically complete a full charge when parked, requiring zero manual driver intervention.
it is important because it eliminates key infrastructure and convenience barriers in clean transportation. By enabling continuous, automated charging on the move and at rest, this solution extends driving range, reduces the need for massive, expensive vehicle batteries, and accelerates the transition toward sustainable, smart-city mobility.
details:
itis a wireless charging system designed to power electric vehicles (EVs) without using physical cables or plugs.

It combines two distinct charging methods into a single solution so vehicles can recharge both when parked and while driving.
